comparison.objective: Place a 911 call through a locked phone’s emergency interface without attempting a passcode.
comparison.physical_skill: Precise glass touches and swipe/tap sequencing with correction of dialling errors.
comparison.success_condition: Clean emergency-route call held for 3 seconds earns full credit; any six-digit passcode attempt permanently fails.
comparison.reason: This is touchscreen interaction and safe interface navigation, with no mechanical force, alignment, locking, or dynamic tuning.
